Hi all — quick technical note on how we can operationalize the split so AP can post cleanly: 

1) Single consolidated PDF with two legal-entity sections (preferred for customer convenience):
   - Invoice will have a header for each legal entity ("Randall Health, Inc." / "Randall Health UK Ltd.") with separate subtotal/VAT lines.
   - Each line item will include: service description, period, token counts (if usage), USD amount, USD to GBP conversion (if applicable), GL code, and cost-center tag.

2) Accounting delivery options (you choose one):
   a) One PDF + two accounting invoices in our financial system (so you get distinct invoice numbers per legal entity but one combined document).
   b) Two fully separate PDFs/invoices (one per legal entity).

3) VAT treatment: for Randall Health UK Ltd — we will apply VAT on the UK invoice section where our supply is UK taxable. If the supply qualifies for reverse-charge, we will leave VAT at 0% and include the reverse-charge note; please confirm VAT registration number for the UK entity in the matrix.

4) Cost-center mapping: please populate the GL codes column in the attached matrix. We'll echo the GL codes onto each invoice line for your ERP.

5) Required docs to attach: signed SoF, allocation spreadsheet, and the PO references. We can include a single-page cover note as well.

Action items for Justine:
- Confirm whether you prefer option (a) or (b) above for delivery.
- Fill VAT reg number for UK entity on the matrix and confirm GL codes for the three cost centers.

If you confirm option (a), we'll produce invoice numbers INV-RAND-202711-01 (US) and INV-RAND-202711-02 (UK) and generate the consolidated PDF that contains both.
